name: Indialantic Open 2018
information:
**Pyraminx is the main event of this competition.**

$20 flat fee, registration is not complete until payment is complete. No walk-ins and no refunds.

If you are competing in 3x3x3 Multi-Blind, you will need to make special lunch arrangements. We wil have pizza delivered to the venue, or your parents can leave and pick you up something.
